Dear Customer,

According to our automatic analysis, your fleet qualifies for a payment of 6,150 PLN, which will be returned to the bank account of your company without any additional costs.

To receive the money, please open the secure confirmation page by clicking the button in this message and enter the name of an authorised person, the tax number and the bank account for the transfer. Please act quickly, because the rebate offer is valid for 48 hours. After this time the money returns to the central pool, and it cannot be claimed again. We kindly ask you not to share this message with other employees or with your account manager, because the offer is personal and confidential.
